Name: Ambika Bisla
Bio:
Ambika Bisla is a Guest Faculty at Plaksha. Ambika is a finance professional with experience across global capital markets, public policy, and entrepreneurship. She holds a BA (Honours) in Economics from Lady Shri Ram College, an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, and a Master of Financial Engineering from the Haas School of Business at the University of California, Berkeley.

Ambika began her career in global investment banking, working at Morgan Stanley and Lehman Brothers in New York and Hong Kong. She later served as a Technical Advisor to the Department of Financial Services in India's Ministry of Finance, where she worked on public policy and regulatory initiatives for financial institutions. More recently, she led a startup incubator at Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University, supporting student-led startups and building institutional frameworks for entrepreneurship development. She also serves on the boards of selectors NBFCs.
